title.zh: AI教育项目把课程标准、教师工作流与安全护栏放在一起设计
title.en: AI education programmes combine curriculum standards, teacher workflows, and safety guardrails

summary.zh: Google DeepMind披露与印度Atal Innovation Mission合作，把机器人、编程和受课程标准约束的AI助手引入学校与教师工作流。值得关注的是，教育科技竞争正在从模型演示转向内容治理、教师参与、学生数据保护和学习结果评估。它也提示工程教育需要把AI工具嵌入可验证的学习任务，而不是只增加一个聊天入口。
summary.en: Google DeepMind describes work with India's Atal Innovation Mission to bring robotics, coding, and curriculum-grounded AI assistants into schools and teacher workflows. Education technology is shifting from model demonstrations toward content governance, teacher participation, student-data protection, and outcome measurement. Engineering education should embed AI in verifiable learning tasks rather than simply add a chat interface.

watch.zh: 关注AI辅导是否有教师监督、课程依据和可量化学习结果。
watch.en: Watch whether AI tutoring has teacher oversight, curriculum grounding, and measurable outcomes.

title.zh: 多智能体AI开始协助复杂疾病假设生成，但实验验证仍是瓶颈
title.en: Multi-agent AI is assisting complex disease hypotheses, while experimental validation remains the bottleneck

summary.zh: Google DeepMind介绍Co-Scientist在肝病研究中的应用：系统从大量文献中提取机制联系，提出组合治疗假设，再由研究团队进行实验验证。行业趋势是AI从信息整理走向假设空间搜索，但可信度取决于证据质量、可重复实验和失败样本。对结构与材料研发同样适用：AI可以加速候选方案筛选，却不能跳过物理试验与独立复核。
summary.en: Google DeepMind describes Co-Scientist being used in liver-disease research to extract mechanisms, propose combination-treatment hypotheses, and support experimental testing. AI is moving from information organisation toward searching hypothesis spaces, but credibility still depends on evidence quality, reproducible experiments, and failed cases. The same applies to structural and materials R&D: AI may accelerate candidate screening but cannot bypass physical testing and independent review.

watch.zh: 关注AI生成的候选机制能否形成可复现、可证伪的实验路径。
watch.en: Watch whether AI-generated mechanisms lead to reproducible and falsifiable experiments.

liveUpdates.reference: Google DeepMind biomedical AI case study

referenceLinks.label: Google DeepMind: Co-Scientist and liver disease research

title.zh: 多智能体系统的安全研究开始从单模型评估转向协同行为风险
title.en: AI safety research is expanding from single-model tests to risks in coordinated multi-agent behaviour

summary.zh: Google DeepMind公布多智能体AI安全研究方向，关注多个模型协作时出现的协调失败、能力叠加和难以预测的群体行为。对工程行业而言，这类系统若进入设计审查、项目调度或自动化运维，必须保留权限边界、人工复核、日志追踪和故障降级。评价一个智能体的准确率，不足以证明整个工作流可安全交付。
summary.en: Google DeepMind outlines multi-agent AI safety research on coordination failures, capability aggregation, and emergent group behaviour when several models work together. In engineering, systems used for design review, project scheduling, or automated operations need permission boundaries, human review, traceable logs, and graceful failure modes. Accuracy of one agent does not establish that the whole workflow is safe to deploy.

watch.zh: 关注多智能体系统的权限隔离、协作失败和人工接管机制。
watch.en: Watch permission isolation, coordination failures, and human takeover mechanisms in multi-agent systems.

referenceLinks.label: Google DeepMind: Multi-agent AI safety research

title.zh: 抗震性能越来越依赖构造细节，而不仅是弹性分析结果
title.en: Seismic performance increasingly depends on detailing, not only elastic analysis results

summary.zh: 抗震工程的关键转向，是把塑性机制、延性路径和节点构造作为分析模型的组成部分。箍筋约束、锚固、搭接、节点核心区和薄弱层控制，决定计算中假定的延性是否能在真实结构中实现。对未来设计而言，自动化分析应同时输出构造可实施性检查，而不能把规范条文留在模型之外。
summary.en: A central shift in seismic engineering is treating plastic mechanisms, ductile load paths, and joint detailing as part of the analytical model. Confinement, anchorage, laps, joint cores, and soft-storey control determine whether assumed ductility can be realised in the built structure. Future automation should report constructability checks alongside analysis rather than leaving code detailing outside the model.

watch.zh: 关注分析模型的延性假定是否能被节点、锚固和箍筋构造兑现。
watch.en: Watch whether ductility assumptions in the model are delivered by joints, anchorage, and transverse reinforcement.

title.zh: 既有建筑抗震加固从单点补强转向体系识别与性能目标管理
title.en: Existing-building seismic retrofit is moving from isolated strengthening to system identification and performance objectives

summary.zh: 既有结构加固首先要识别真实的传力路径、材料状态、非结构构件影响和潜在薄弱层，再选择增设墙、支撑、节点补强或耗能构件。研究与工程实践都表明，局部提高强度可能把破坏转移到更脆弱的部位。更稳健的流程是把调查不确定性、目标性能、施工阶段和震后可修复性放进同一决策框架。
summary.en: Retrofit of existing structures begins with identifying actual load paths, material condition, nonstructural effects, and potential weak storeys before selecting walls, braces, joint strengthening, or energy-dissipating devices. Increasing local strength can transfer failure to a more brittle region. A more robust workflow puts survey uncertainty, target performance, construction staging, and post-earthquake reparability into one decision framework.

watch.zh: 关注加固是否改善整体机制，而不是只提高某个构件的承载力。
watch.en: Watch whether retrofit improves the global mechanism rather than only increasing one member's capacity.

title.zh: 性能化抗震评估把位移、损伤状态与修复决策连接起来
title.en: Performance-based seismic assessment connects drift, damage states, and repair decisions

summary.zh: 性能化方法不只问结构是否不倒，还要区分生命安全、可修复性和功能保持等目标，并将地震需求映射到构件损伤与系统停用后果。PEER等研究框架推动了从单一强度指标到多性能目标的评估。对设计技术的发展而言，关键是保持地震动、模型假定、损伤判据与决策成本之间的可追溯链条。
summary.en: Performance-based methods ask more than whether a structure avoids collapse: they distinguish life safety, reparability, and functional recovery, mapping seismic demand to component damage and downtime consequences. Research frameworks such as PEER have advanced assessment beyond a single strength metric. The technical priority is a traceable chain from ground motion and model assumptions to damage criteria and decision cost.

watch.zh: 关注性能目标、损伤判据和修复成本是否在项目初期被明确。
watch.en: Watch whether performance objectives, damage criteria, and repair cost are defined early in the project.

title.zh: 抗震不是把力算大：中国与国外如何通过构造控制破坏？
title.en: Seismic design is not just larger forces: how Chinese and international practice controls failure through detailing

intro.zh: 本期比较抗震设计中“需求—机制—构造”的关系。不同体系的条文表达并不相同，但共同目标是让预期的延性机制先于脆性破坏发生，并让构造要求能够在施工中被检查。
intro.en: This issue compares the relationship between demand, mechanism, and detailing in seismic design. Provisions differ across systems, but the shared objective is to make the intended ductile mechanism precede brittle failure and make detailing verifiable during construction.

title.zh: 中国：构造措施强化延性路径
title.en: China: detailing reinforces the ductile load path

text.zh: GB 50011将抗震等级、构件类别和构造要求联系起来，设计不能只看计算配筋。
text.en: GB 50011 links seismic grade, member type, and detailing; design cannot rely on calculated reinforcement alone.

title.zh: 国际实践：能力设计与性能目标并行
title.en: International practice: capacity design and performance objectives work together

text.zh: AS 1170.4、ASCE/SEI 7和EN 1998-1分别以体系规则、能力设计或性能要求控制塑性机制。
text.en: AS 1170.4, ASCE/SEI 7, and EN 1998-1 control plastic mechanisms through system rules, capacity design, or performance requirements.

title.zh: 共同要求：细部必须可检查
title.en: Shared requirement: details must be inspectable

text.zh: 无论采用何种规范，节点、锚固、箍筋和搭接都应能在图纸与现场检查中追溯。
text.en: Regardless of the code system, joints, anchorage, transverse reinforcement, and laps should be traceable in drawings and site inspection.

takeaway.zh: 抗震设计的核心是需求—机制—构造—修复的闭环；规范计算只有与真实细部和可施工性一致，才具有工程意义。
takeaway.en: The core of seismic design is a loop from demand to mechanism, detailing, and repair; code calculations matter only when they match real details and constructability.

title.zh: 参考实例：层间位移角的概念筛查

intro.zh: 以下关系是派生的概念表达，不是某一规范的编号公式。正式设计必须按采用的抗震规范、性能目标、二阶效应和构造要求复核。
intro.en: The following are derived conceptual expressions, not numbered code equations. Formal design must follow the adopted seismic code, performance objective, second-order effects, and detailing requirements.

citation.zh: Derived relation；以层间位移Δ与层高h之比表示变形需求，不能单独替代规范性能验算。
citation.en: Derived relation; expresses deformation demand as interstorey displacement Δ divided by storey height h and cannot replace a code performance check.

citation.zh: Derived relation；比较计算位移角θ与目标限值θl的量级，限值必须来自项目性能目标和适用规范。
citation.en: Derived relation; compares calculated drift θ with target limit θl, which must come from the project objective and applicable provisions.

label.zh: 层间变形增量（派生关系）

citation.zh: Derived relation；用相邻楼层水平位移差表示层间位移，需与扭转、节点变形和非结构构件损伤共同解释。
citation.en: Derived relation; defines interstorey displacement as the difference between adjacent floor displacements and must be interpreted with torsion, joint deformation, and nonstructural damage.

note.zh: 正式抗震实例应明确地震动、质量、刚度、阻尼、偶然偏心、构造延性、非线性分析方法和性能限值。可对照AS 1170.4、ASCE/SEI 7、EN 1998-1及中国GB 50011相关条文，具体版本必须核对。
note.en: A formal seismic example should define ground motions, mass, stiffness, damping, accidental eccentricity, ductility detailing, nonlinear method, and performance limits. Compare AS 1170.4, ASCE/SEI 7, EN 1998-1, and relevant Chinese provisions in GB 50011; check exact clauses against the project edition.

text.zh: 抗震设计不能只把地震作用转化为构件内力；还必须通过能力设计、延性构造和可检查的施工细节，把预期破坏机制落实到真实结构。
text.en: Seismic design cannot stop at converting earthquake actions into member forces; capacity design, ductile detailing, and inspectable construction details must make the intended failure mechanism real.
